doc:
### PROPOSAL-10 — Art Deco Noir - **slug**: `art-deco` - **Vibe**: 1920s gold-on-black luxury — geometric sunbursts, chevron lines, and champagne accents over deep noir. - **Best for**: Earnings dashboard and campaign calendar — premium, quiet opulence for high-ticket affiliate reporting. Adjectives: luxurious, geometric, refined. - **Palette** (dark theme, `is_dark: true`): | Token | Value | Usage | |---|---|---| | `--bg-canvas` | `#0d0b09` | Deep warm-black noir canvas | | `--bg-surface` | `#161310` | Charcoal panel fill | | `--bg-surface-elevated` | `#211d18` | Raised panels, modals | | `--border-subtle` | `#2c261e` | Fine shadow hairlines | | `--border-default` | `#4a4134` | Standard bronze borders | | `--border-focus` | `#d4af37` | Gold focus outline | | `--text-primary` | `#f5f0e6` | Cream headings and body | | `--text-secondary` | `#cfc5b2` | Standard body text | | `--text-muted` | `#8d8271` | Captions, dates, fine print | | `--color-action` | `#d4af37` | Gold primary action | | `--color-action-hover` | `#b8942f` | Action hover (deeper gold) | | `--color-earnings` | `#e6d3a0` | Champagne earnings | | `--color-earnings-hover` | `#d9c489` | Earnings hover (deeper champagne) | | `--color-automation` | `#c7d1d8` | Chrome-silver automation accents | | `--color-alert` | `#c9922e` | Amber-gold warnings | | `--color-danger` | `#a63a2e` | Dark red destructive states | | `--color-action-glow` | `rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.18)` | Gold tint behind action icons | | `--color-earnings-glow` | `rgba(230, 211, 160, 0.14)` | Champagne tint behind earnings icons | | `--color-automation-glow` | `rgba(199, 209, 216, 0.12)` | Silver tint behind automation icons | - **Typography**: Display: `"Cinzel", "Marcellus", serif` — Roman inscriptional caps, `letter-spacing: 0.06em`, used for headings and KPI labels. Sans/body: `"Cormorant Garamond", "EB Garamond", Georgia, serif` at 500-600 (elegant serif body). Mono: `"IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` for timestamps and IDs. Numerals `tabular-nums`; overlines in Cinzel small caps. - **Radii & Borders**: Sharp and architectural — 0-2px radius. Borders are thin 1px gold/bronze lines; cards use a **double-line deco frame** (outer 1px + inner hairline inset 3px). Dividers are chevron or sunburst motifs, never plain rules. - **Component Patterns**: - **Buttons**: Rectangular, thin gold border, uppercase Cinzel label with wide tracking. Primary = gold fill with black text (`#0d0b09`); hover = champagne. Secondary = transparent with gold border; tertiary = text-only with gold underline. Focus = gold double outline. - **Cards**: Noir panels with the double-line gold frame, a chevron divider under the header, and a faint sunburst watermark in the corner. No shadows; depth is implied by gold line weight. - **Badges/Status**: Small gold-outlined pills with a diamond status mark (deco, not round); publishing = pulsing gold diamond; published = champagne; failed = dark red diamond. - **Tables**: Noir with thin gold rules; header row in cream Cinzel caps; row hover = 1px gold left rule. - **Forms/Inputs**: Fields with a single gold baseline; focus = gold double underline. Labels in small cream caps. - **Loading**: A rotating sunburst fan (12 rays) or three chevrons sliding in sequence; determinate = a gold segment gauge. - **Signature detail**: The sunburst/chevron geometric divider and gold double-line frames — pure Gatsby-era geometry on noir black. - **Motion & Animation**: Measured and stately — 300ms `ease-in-out`; content fades in with a 8px upward drift (velvet curtain feel). Status changes cross-fade; nothing pops or bounces. - **Signature Preview Snippet**: ```html
EARNINGS THIS QUARTER $48,210 +22% vs prior
```
